notes: Model pilot (haiku arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole feeds the held pole bonsai1/L29/N7370+ (zeroing this neuron removes 1.00 of the anchor's peak), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Haiku 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes: the quote before 'pt' in a locale setting scored 0.81, but the dropdown and name-field probes only reached 0.17 to 0.19, so the pole fires mainly on a quoted code inside a setting. Near misses use the same settings frames with quoted non-language values, which stayed low in the probes. A quoted language code in other contexts may stay below threshold, so expect a partial result.
